label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 49
title: MVP: instance-role UI gating - operator pages only on operator instance; hidden+blocked for customers
body: Render the operator surfaces (operator console, onboarding, customer/license mgmt) under /operator/* ONLY when INSTANCE_ROLE=operator AND the user is platform_admin. On a tenant instance (customer deployment, local/dev or self-hosted) these routes are absent and APIs return 403. Customer admins only get their tenant admin (users/teams/roles/seats/quotas/billing). Depends on backend BI-0059.
